database.adopt_confirm:
Switch to the dry-run SQLite copy?

Nimbalyst will:
  1. Close the current PGLite database
  2. Copy anything new since the dry-run ({{age}} ago)
  3. Make SQLite the active backend
  4. Preserve the old PGLite for rollback

A relaunch is required after switching.
database.rollback_confirm: Restore the preserved PGLite database? You will lose any data created since the migration. Requires a relaunch.
database.preserve_and_switch: Preserving the previous PGLite directory and switching the active backend.
database.adopt_description: A successful dry-run from {{age}} is saved on disk ({{rows}} rows). Nimbalyst can promote it to be your active database — it will copy anything new since the dry-run, then switch the backend. The current PGLite directory is preserved for rollback.
